posts.text: JUST IN: 🇷🇺 🇺🇸 Russian President Putin says he has no doubt President Trump genuinely wants to end the war in Ukraine and improve relations with Russia. @BRICSNews

🇺🇸 🇨🇳 🇷🇺 ⚡️ — The meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin is "another sign of the end of the unipolar world order, in which the United States dominated," and a more uncertain and unstable reality may emerge in its place, according to the American newspaper The Wall Street Journal. While the meeting in Shenzhen was an "unprecedented demonstration of unity" among the holders of the three largest nuclear arsenals in the world, the leaders of the United States, China, and Russia remain divided by competing ambitions and sharply contrasting views on what the new world order should look like. None of the three leaders is in a position to unilaterally dictate the rules for the others. Russia and the United States are embroiled in conflicts, while Beijing faces growing economic challenges and is extremely reluctant to assume the role of global leader that the United States has historically played. What unites them is a desire to maximize their freedom of action within their perceived spheres of influence: Russia considers Ukraine to be within its sphere, China considers Taiwan to be within its, and the United States considers the Western Hemisphere to be within its. According to the WSJ, there were virtually no signs of potential progress on key issues before the meeting: the wars in Ukraine, Iran, and the proliferation of nuclear weapons. For the participants, the very fact of the meeting and the opportunity to demonstrate their position on the world stage were arguably more important than resolving specific problems. @Intelslava

📝 Agreed to keep talking 📝 What they came to in Shenzhen The meeting of three leaders in China has effectively concluded, and if we set aside all the statements, the main outcome of this event is this — the parties committed to maintaining constructive interaction going forward. 📌 The joint statement published after the meeting concludes addresses the international security system in broad strokes, where its control instruments have long ceased to serve as guarantors of stability. Of course, this refers to the United Nations and the International Criminal Court, which both Trump and Xi Jinping drew attention to. And the nuclear weapons topic was not left on the sidelines — control holds the key to world security. 🖍 But overall, for Russia the main takeaway is that the state has not been isolated in the international arena. Russia is sought out for contacts and actively continues interaction. However, the Ukrainian question was not raised at the summit. This confirms our assessment that the Middle Kingdom intended to keep this topic off the agenda. Therefore, there was no reason to expect a breakthrough on the peaceful settlement issue, since China simply has no interest in it. ❗️ The end of the SMO, as before, will depend on realities on the ground. That is why it is so important to advance our goals and objectives through the total weakening of the Ukrainian regime, and this will only be possible through the destruction of its potential. The more that gets destroyed on the territory of so-called Ukraine (ports, factories, bridges, energy infrastructure), the less beneficial it will be for the West to support it. And half-measures will not achieve this. #China #Russia #USA ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

Россия, Китай и США приняли совместную декларацию о мире Владимир Путин, Си Цзиньпин и Дональд Трамп по итогам первой в истории трёхсторонней встречи в Шэньчжэне приняли Декларацию о мире. Лидеры трёх держав договорились вести диалог о снижении ядерных рисков, выступили за реформирование ООН и подтвердили необходимость стабильных поставок энергоресурсов. Текст Декларации о мире публикует Кремль: 1. Являясь постоянными членами Совета Безопасности ООН, Россия, Китай и США выразили приверженность реформированию ООН, чтобы ООН могла более эффективно реагировать на глобальные вызовы и соответствовать своей основополагающей миссии в области международного мира и безопасности. 2. Три государства планируют увеличить производство и поставки продуктов нефтепереработки на благо всех стран. Они подтвердили важность стабильных энергопоставок. 3. Главы трёх государств отмечают, что принцип согласия государств и соблюдение иммунитетов официальных лиц государств имеют основополагающее значение, и согласны с тем, что Международный уголовный суд и другие аналогичные структуры не должны злоупотреблять своими полномочиями. 4. Главы трёх государств подтвердили, что в ядерной войне не может быть победителей и она никогда не должна быть развязана. Три страны будут вести диалог по снижению ядерных рисков и предотвращению распространения ядерного оружия. Отдельное внимание в документе уделено Международному уголовному суду (МУС). Россия, Китай и США подчеркнули важность соблюдения государственного суверенитета и иммунитетов официальных лиц, заявив, что МУС и аналогичные структуры не должны злоупотреблять своими полномочиями. @wargonzo

The Russia-China-US Heads of State Declaration toward Peace adopted following the trilateral meeting The following is the full text of the declaration: Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation, Xi Jinping, President of the People's Republic of China, and Donald J. Trump, President of the United States of America, met in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The Russian and U.S. heads of state expressed appreciation to China for hosting this historic trilateral Summit. The three heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on the current international situation and committed to maintaining strategic stability and international security. 1. As permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, Russia, China and the United States committed to reform the U.N. so that the U.N. can respond more effectively to global challenges and conform to its fundamental mission of international peace and security. 2. The three countries plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products for the benefit of all nations. They reaffirmed the importance of stable energy flows. 3. The three heads of state recognized that the principle of state consent and respect for immunities of State officials are of paramount importance, and concurred that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction. 4. The three heads of state reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought. The three countries will conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

🇪🇺 🇺🇦 While Putin sat at the table with Trump and Xi in Shenzhen, Zelensky is spending today in Berlin with what even Politico now calls the "Coalition of the Wobbling." The outlet describes the so-called Coalition of the Willing as a motley group of small and medium-sized countries, led by two weak European leaders and a rookie without a mandate. European officials told Politico the leadership is weaker than it has been in years and could be made irrelevant by any deal Trump strikes with Putin. The co-chairs aren't in great shape. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz barely held on to his job after what he himself called an electoral "disaster," and French President Emmanuel Macron is historically unpopular, with Marine Le Pen's camp surging ahead of next year's presidential election. Britain's new prime minister, Andy Burnham, took over from Keir Starmer in July without winning an election and is still "finding his way." The coalition hasn't held a leaders' meeting since August, as momentum faded after the US and Israel launched their war on Iran. On the agenda now: security guarantees for Kiev, a multinational force to police a ceasefire that doesn't exist, more money and more air defense. Brussels has already proposed another €45 billion loan for Ukraine for 2027. Even a senior Ukrainian official admits this group may be "as good as it gets." 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
